translationRepairs: When Emperor Xuanzong moved to Bian, the remainder was a temple built to the right of the palace courtyard inside the Gate of Assembly as prescribed; the spring and autumn upper-wu sacrifices continued as before.
When Emperor Xuanzong moved to Bian, a temple was built to the right of the palace courtyard inside the Gate of Assembly as prescribed; the spring and autumn upper-wu sacrifices continued as before.

s0060 has 宣宗遷汴，餘會朝門內闕庭之右營廟如制; after the move, 營廟如制 is the verb phrase 'built a temple as prescribed,' and 餘 is connective continuation, not a subject meaning 'the remainder.' The literal's 'the remainder was a temple built' is a real mistranslation; the proposed wording is accurate and natural.
